verdict.rationale: Relay's support docs state that ACH takes 1–3 business days, that domestic and international wires can send same-day, and that 'you'll see the exact delivery estimate before confirming,' which matches the story directly. A community review adds that faster same-day ACH is available on the Pro plan, which affects the timing shown. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the estimate appears in the confirmation flow, and in-depth docs showing how the estimate is displayed and calculated for each transfer type.
